decisions.reason: The online customer portal is far from the core business and has no reported results, but it supports the one-stop service and the deeper customer collaboration the firm is aiming for, and a growing, investing firm has the slack to carry it while its value is still uncertain.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 puts this packaging display above aspiration and gives it reputational value, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses.
This quarter-pallet pegboard display sits close to the core business and has its own page, so it is cheap to keep in a growing industry, and no shortfall signals a need to drop it.
The small counter display is a standard core-line item with its own page, so the cost of keeping it is low and it fits the firm's display-only focus.

The large freestanding information display is close to the established offer and promoted on its own page; without evidence of underperformance, the firm's slack lets it keep the product in the portfolio.
